newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish ZEW sees IPO oversubscribed, price PLN 45.
newsitem.headline: Polish ZEW sees IPO oversubscribed, price PLN 45.

text.p: The 800,000-share initial public offering of Polish electrode maker ZEW SA at a minimum price of 38 zlotys will likely be oversubscribed with the shares sold at 45 zlotys, the company's president said on Wednesday.
"It might be necessary to reduce bids...and a price could possibly form at the level of 45 zlotys," Jerzy Szpineter told Reuters. ZEW seeks a main market listing.
The firm's main shareholders are National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 9 in Poland's mass privatisation programme, with a 33-percent stake, and the state treasury, which has 25 percent.
ZEW, whose full name is Zaklady Elektrod Weglowych SA, expects to lift net profit to about six million zlotys this year from 1996's 1.3 million zlotys.
